TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Rejects the creation of a pricing rule
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() gets pricingRuleId through getPricingruleid() and passes it to ABKOR006.executeRejectPricingRule to load the pricing rule to reject. No input validations are performed in execute(); inside the invoked library, validateReject(rule, pricingRuleId) verifies that a rule was retrieved and that its status is PAA, PAU or PAD. 2. Decisions and branches: processRejection(rule, status, pricingRuleId, auditId, auditUserId, repository) calls rejectRule with status REJ when status is PAA or PAU, and with status SYC when status is PAD. In fillDetailValues(details, queriesMap), each detail resolves a query with queriesMap.get(d.getEntityType().getDbValue()) and then resolves its value with jdbcUtils.queryForString(query, d.getId()); if the query is missing, the resolved value is null or blank, or NoResultException is raised, the flow throws a PricingRuleException. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() gets ABKOR006 through getServiceLibrary(ABKOR006.class) and calls executeRejectPricingRule(pricingRuleId). executeRejectPricingRule() loads the rule with repository.getPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId), populates its details with RuleDetailsUtils.populatePricingRuleDetails(rule, pricingRuleId, repository, queriesMap), validates the rejection with PricingRuleValidator.validateReject(rule, pricingRuleId), obtains an audit id with repository.getNextId(QueryConstants.GET_AUDIT_LOG_ID_SEQUENCE), obtains the audit user with getUserId(), writes the audit with repository.insertAudit(...), and updates the rule status with repository.updatePricingRuleStatus(...). 4. Errors and subsequent actions: fillDetailValues() throws ABKO10010004 when a detail query is not configured, returns a null or blank value, or raises NoResultException while resolving a detail value. validateReject() throws ABKO10000405 when repository.getPricingRuleById(pricingRuleId) returns null, and ABKO10000412 when rule.getStatus() is not PAA, PAU or PAD. updatePricingRuleStatus() throws ABKO00000010 when jdbcUtils.update(...) returns 0. executeRejectPricingRule() catches PricingRuleException, adds the advice with addAdviceWithDescription(e.getCode(), e.getDescription()), returns null, and execute() sets severity EWR through assignSeverityError(this.getAdviceList()) when at least one advice exists. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: when executeRejectPricingRule(pricingRuleId) returns a non-null PricingRuleDTO, execute() calls setPricingrule(pricingRuleDTO) and adds pricingRuleResponse with the returned DTO. When executeRejectPricingRule(pricingRuleId) returns null, setPricingrule(pricingRuleDTO) logs the null value and returns without calling addParameter("pricingRuleResponse", field).
